name: Wednesday
description: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

videos.title: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
videos.overview: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

videos.title: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
videos.overview: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

videos.title: Friend or Woe
videos.overview: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

videos.title: Woe What a Night
videos.overview: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

videos.title: You Reap What You Woe
videos.overview: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

videos.title: Quid Pro Woe
videos.overview: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

videos.title: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
videos.overview: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

videos.title: A Murder of Woes
videos.overview: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.

videos.title: Here We Woe Again
videos.overview: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

videos.title: The Devil You Woe
videos.overview: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

videos.title: Call of the Woe
videos.overview: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

videos.title: If These Woes Could Talk
videos.overview: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

videos.title: Hyde and Woe Seek
videos.overview: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

videos.title: Woe Thyself
videos.overview: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

videos.title: Woe Me the Money
videos.overview: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

videos.title: This Means Woe
videos.overview: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

awards: Won 4 Primetime Emmys. 24 wins & 78 nominations total
